config.purpose: Separate primary activity from TDI shift among selected hits; test whether correction for primary-conditioned label availability changes historical concordance.
config.limits: Fit availability propensity on outer-training measured primary response and missingness only. Missing class labels are selection outcomes, never TDI-negative outcomes. MAR and positivity are unverified; clipping does not fill absent weak-activity labels. Primary response is used for evaluation weighting, not a deployable hidden assay feature.

limits: No weighting recovers unobserved outcomes; label selection can depend on unmeasured outcomes, violating MAR. Historical successes have partial-pool OOF and failures complete-pool OOF, explicitly separate scopes. No blind individual labels are inferred, no candidate is created.
